pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with sharp pixel-level gradients between dark brown and cream; spatial area is high in the mid-flank, with patches appearing as distinct, non-overlapping geometric islands.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light pelage pathways exhibiting narrow, uniform pixel thickness in the lower flank; nodes are predominantly triradiate (Y-junctions) forming a high-contrast topological mesh.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Massive, hyper-pigmented, cauliflower-like textural disruptions covering the majority of the dorsal ridge and upper neck, characterized by dark, raised nodular silhouettes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple isolated, raised, dark-toned nodular lesions are visible across the mid-flank and lower neck, distinct from the base pelage coloration.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian specimen (likely an oxpecker) positioned on the upper-left dorsal lesion area.
